text:
jamie_sales: Opening thread for NovaBank POC - need final decisions on SAML/SCIM auth, RBAC mapping style, domain claim process, and a committed Dedicated estimate. Goal: handoff to infra tomorrow.

priya_se: Quick checklist from eng: IdP metadata (XML or URL), NameID format, SP vs IdP-initiated, SCIM auth method, list of domains for verification, and whether you want route-level entitlements.

client_admin_novabank: We'll provide IdP metadata URL today. NameID=email. SP-initiated. SCIM: bearer token ok for POC, will evaluate mTLS for prod. Domains: novabank.com, novabank-eu.com, and payments.novabank.com.

marco_ts: For RBAC - do you prefer groups->roles mapping OR claims-based roles (employeeType claim)? If groups, share canonical group names. If claims, share example SAML assertion. Also confirm externalId format.

client_admin_novabank: Groups->roles is preferred for now. externalId = "nb|<employee-id>". We'll send group list.

laura_security: Security notes: 1) POC with bearer token OK, prod should use mTLS. 2) Audit logs: default 90d, enterprise 365d (pricing delta). 3) SAML cert rotation: we support manual replace + automated metadata refresh if IdP exposes. 4) Domain claim: we'll require DNS TXT on each domain; if you want org-level delegation (one parent claim for subdomains) we can discuss but it needs ownership proof for each domain owner. Expect ~1-3 business days per domain.

mark_legal: Legal needs a short SOW clause for SSO/SCIM for budget sign-off. We'll include cert rotation, provisioning termination, and data residency. Can draft template quickly.

priya_se: SCIM implementation notes for the POC: set initial sync rate-limit to 50 req/min; map groups to RBAC roles in the POC config. Example SCIM payload we'll use for tests:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],"Resources":[{"id":"u-321","userName":"p.adams@novabank.com","externalId":"nb|321","emails":[{"value":"p.adams@novabank.com"}],"groups":["payments","ops"]}]}
```
Mapping: payments->payments-analyst, ops->infra-operator.

jamie_sales: Pricing ask: committed Dedicated estimate for 125 req/s sustained, ~1.3M tokens/day. Need reserved monthly + overage, 24/7 enterprise support, EU data residency. Also call out extra for route-level entitlements.

marco_ts: I'll draft a line-item estimate: reserved GPU pool monthly, overage per 1k tokens, support add-on, extended logs, and a 'route-level RBAC' premium. Note caveat: quantized models and tight latency SLOs may require higher commit.

client_admin_novabank: Legal needs SOW clause + draft estimate within 24h to move budget. Also confirm EU region availability.

mark_legal: I'll post a short SOW snippet to the thread and attach template link.

laura_security: I'll fill out the security questionnaire and add a note: if you enable per-route logging or tenant-scoped audit keys, implementation time + cost increase. Also, consider rotating SCIM bearer token every 90 days during POC.

priya_se: Implementation plan for POC: 1) ingest IdP metadata and configure SP-initiated SAML in staging; 2) configure SCIM with groups->roles mapping and run smoke sync; 3) validate DNS TXT for the three domains; 4) run load test with KV/prefix cache to measure latency; 5) handoff sizing if pass.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/nb-poc-identity-config -> staging at 2024-10-15T07:45Z :rocket:

jamie_sales: Thanks team. Action items: client sends metadata + group list + SCIM token today; Marco to send estimate; Mark to post SOW clause; Laura to complete security QA. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
